Retroactive public goods funding (RPGF) is one application of the decentralized curation framework. The public-goods companion is the current application paper. It develops ongoing assessment of contributions and funding when a beneficiary budget is available, using the foundational paper's accuracy and relevance distinction.

- [Read the public-goods companion](./companion/)
- [Back to the thesis paper](../)

## Historical material

The companion supersedes the [earlier fixed-round design](./design/). That document remains available for provenance; its rules do not define the current application.
